en.description: Track company card payments, scan receipts and manage complete business accounting — all in one place.

landing.headline: Every company expense tracked and accounted
landing.subheadline: Business owners scan receipts, log card payments and close the books without switching between tools.

features.title: Company Card Payments
features.description: Log and categorise every card transaction as it happens, with no manual data entry needed.

features.title: Receipt Scanning
features.description: Photograph paper receipts and cash payment slips to capture the amount, date and category automatically.

features.title: Reports & Predictions
features.description: View monthly expense summaries and spending forecasts to keep your budget on track.

features.title: Full Accounting
features.description: Record and classify every transaction so your books are always ready for your accountant or tax return.

howItWorks.heading: From receipt to record in seconds

steps.title: Sign in
steps.description: Log in with your Google account to access your company's expense workspace.

steps.title: Add an expense
steps.description: Enter a card payment manually or photograph a receipt to scan it straight into the register.

steps.title: Categorise
steps.description: Assign the expense to the right category and payment type, then set its approval status.

steps.title: Review & export
steps.description: Check your dashboard for totals and trends, then export the data for your accountant.

items.question: Can I scan cash receipts?
items.answer: Yes — photograph any paper receipt or cash payment block and the system records the amount, date and description for you.

items.question: How are company card payments tracked?
items.answer: You can log card transactions manually; each entry is linked to a category and approval status in your expense register.

items.question: Can I generate expense reports?
items.answer: The dashboard shows a live summary of your expenses. Filter by category, payment type or status and export the data at any time.

items.question: Is my data private?
items.answer: Your expense records are tied to your Google account and visible only to you and the people you explicitly authorise.

dashboard.title: Expense Dashboard
dashboard.intro: An overview of your company expenses — totals, approval statuses and spending trends at a glance.

cta.label: Sign in and start
cta.title: Take control of company spending
cta.subtitle: Sign in with Google and start logging, scanning and reporting your business expenses today.

listings.heading: Plans & Modules
listings.intro: Choose the plan that fits your business. Scan receipts, manage company cards and close your books — at the scale you need.
listings.notice: These plans are illustrative examples; the owner will publish current pricing before going live.

plan-starter.title: Starter Plan
plan-starter.summary: Track personal and small-business expenses with receipt scanning and basic reporting, free of charge.

plan-business.title: Business Plan
plan-business.summary: Full expense management for small teams: company card tracking, receipt scanning and monthly expense reports.

plan-enterprise.title: Enterprise Plan
plan-enterprise.summary: Complete accounting for larger companies with a full ledger, advanced predictions and priority support.

sk.description: Evidujte firemné platby kartou, skenujte bločky a spravujte kompletné účtovníctvo — všetko na jednom mieste.

landing.headline: Každý firemný výdavok evidovaný a zaúčtovaný
landing.subheadline: Podnikatelia skenujú bločky, evidujú platby kartou a uzatvárajú účtovníctvo bez prepínania medzi nástrojmi.
landing.featuresHeading: Všetko, čo vaše firemné účtovníctvo potrebuje

features.title: Platby firemnou kartou
features.description: Zaznamenajte a zatrieďte každú transakciu kartou ihneď bez nutnosti ručného zadávania údajov.

features.title: Skenovanie bločkov
features.description: Odfotografujte papierový bloček alebo doklad o platbe v hotovosti a systém zachytí sumu, dátum a kategóriu.

features.title: Reporty a predikcie
features.description: Sledujte mesačné prehľady výdavkov a predpovede čerpania rozpočtu, aby ste mali financie pod kontrolou.

features.title: Kompletné účtovníctvo
features.description: Zaznamenajte a klasifikujte každú transakciu, aby boli vaše záznamy vždy pripravené pre účtovníka.

howItWorks.heading: Od bločka k záznamu za niekoľko sekúnd

steps.title: Prihláste sa
steps.description: Prihláste sa svojím Google účtom a vstúpte do pracovného priestoru výdavkov vašej firmy.

steps.title: Pridajte výdavok
steps.description: Zadajte transakciu kartou ručne alebo odfotografujte bloček a naskenujte ho priamo do registra.

steps.title: Kategorizujte
steps.description: Priraďte výdavok správnej kategórii a spôsobu platby, potom nastavte stav schválenia.

steps.title: Skontrolujte a exportujte
steps.description: Pozrite si prehľad na dashboarde a exportujte dáta pre svojho účtovníka alebo daňové priznanie.

items.question: Môžem skenovať bločky z hotovostných platieb?
items.answer: Áno — odfotografujte akýkoľvek papierový bloček alebo doklad a systém zapíše sumu, dátum a popis za vás.

items.question: Ako sa evidujú platby firemnou kartou?
items.answer: Transakcie kartou zadávate ručne; každá je priradená ku kategórii a stavu schválenia v registri výdavkov.

items.question: Môžem generovať reporty výdavkov?
items.answer: Dashboard zobrazuje živý prehľad vašich výdavkov. Filtrujte podľa kategórie, spôsobu platby alebo stavu a kedykoľvek exportujte dáta.

items.question: Sú moje dáta v bezpečí?
items.answer: Záznamy výdavkov sú viazané na váš Google účet a viditeľné iba vám a osobám, ktoré sami autorizujete.

dashboard.title: Prehľad výdavkov
dashboard.intro: Prehľad firemných výdavkov — celkové sumy, stavy schválenia a trendy čerpania na prvý pohľad.
